mechanism_narrative: Higher federal funds rate levels compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates for future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level against 5d SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5d returns when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it triggers aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of months when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or t-test of triggered vs non-triggered returns is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and consumer price inflation signal dual monetary and inflationary shocks that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or negative returns are not observed when both series rise by 0.25pp and 0.5% respectively.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes, labor market tightness accelerates wage growth and profit margin compression, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 40% of months when UNRATE < 4.0%, or average returns in this regime are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate falls below 4.0%, it signals labor market overheating that increases inflation expectations and reduces equity demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 40% of months when UNRATE < 4.0%, or t-test of triggered vs non-triggered returns is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Higher residential construction permits indicate robust consumer demand and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST level against 60d SPX returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 60d returns when HOUST > 1200 are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits and consumer spending on durable goods signal strong aggregate demand, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or positive returns are not observed when both series rise by 5% and 2% respectively.

mechanism_narrative: In high industrial production growth regimes, manufacturing output expansion improves supply chain efficiency and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 40% of months when INDPRO > 105, or average returns in this regime are not significantly positive (p>0.05).
